parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $P(HRR)=\frac14\times\frac46\times\frac46=\frac{16}{144}=\frac4{36}$; $P(TRR)=\frac34\times\frac37\times\frac26=\frac{18}{168}=\frac3{28}$; $P(HBB)=\frac14\times\frac26\times\frac26=\frac4{144}=\frac1{36}$; $P(TBB)=\frac34\times\frac47\times\frac36=\frac{36}{168}=\frac6{28}=\frac3{14}$ (B1). Guidance: 2 clearly identified unsimplified probabilities from $P(HRR)$, $P(TRR)$, $P(HBB)$ and $P(TBB)$ correct. $\frac4{36}+\frac3{28}+\frac1{36}+\frac6{28}$ (M1). Guidance: sum of 4 correct scenarios, which may be identified by the unsimplified probability calculations. $=\frac{29}{63}$ or $0.460$ (A1). Guidance: $0.460317\ldots$ to at least 3 significant figures. Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $[P(T\mid BB)=\frac{P(T\cap BB)}{P(BB)}]=\frac{\frac34\times\frac47\times\frac36}{\frac1{36}+\frac6{28}}$; equivalently $\frac3{14}\div\frac{61}{252}$ or $\frac{\frac3{14}}{\frac{61}{252}}$. Numerator (M1) guidance: $\frac34\times\frac47\times\frac36$, $\frac{36}{168}$ or equivalent, $\frac3{14}$, or $0.2142857\ldots$ seen as the numerator of a fraction; accept unsimplified; FT their $P(TBB)$ from 4(a). Denominator (M1) guidance: their $\frac1{36}$ plus their $\frac6{28}$, FT from 4(a), or correct $0.24206\ldots$, seen as the denominator of a fraction; accept unsimplified. $=\frac{54}{61}$ or $0.885$ (A1). Accept $0.8852589\ldots$ rounded to at least 3 significant figures. If one or both M marks are not awarded, SC B1 for the correct final answer WWW. Total: 3.
